resolutions.researcher_notes: Original ref (gxsngc.com) fails url_verifier — resolves to an unrelated Nanning consulting firm's homepage, no 兴业 content. Fresh Chinese search on Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipeline Network Co.'s (广西广投天然气管网有限公司) own e-procurement portal (gigeps.com) turned up two live, on-topic official notices naming the Xingye branch/station directly: (1) 79585.htm (2026-05-22, reissue of 77172.htm) — procurement for a road-safety evaluation to renew the '兴业分输站进站道口' (Xingye distribution-station entrance) traffic permit before its 2026-04-12 expiry, i.e. an actively-maintained, in-use facility as of mid-2026; (2) 55045.htm (2025-02-25) — feasibility-study procurement for a valve-room distribution modification explicitly titled '兴业天然气支线管道工程' and stating '目前线路管道已敷设至5#阀室围墙外附近' (the branch pipeline is already laid up to the 5# valve-room perimeter), i.e. physical pipe is already built, not merely planned. Together these support Status=operating (built + actively permitted/maintained) though both come from the same operator's own procurement channel, so tier=medium/independent=false rather than high.

Original ref (bjx.com.cn) fails url_verifier (200 but no 兴业 mention) — confirmed by the prior deep-sweep researcher to be a generic 171-project 2021 Guangxi energy-network policy omnibus that never names this pipeline. Searched '兴业天然气支线管道工程 核准 2021', '兴业天然气支线管道工程 立项 可行性研究报告 2021', dnr.gxzf.gov.cn (Guangxi Natural Resources Dept's construction-land-approval index, which does carry named approvals for sibling branches: Guiping, Laibin Xingbin-Wuxuan, Hepu-Bobai-Pubei) for a Xingye-named land-use or project-approval document — none found. No dedicated 2021-03 approval/proposal notice for Xingye specifically turned up in Chinese search; the two working sources found for this row (gigeps.com procurement notices, see Status/Diameter/Pressure) postdate 2021 and don't speak to a proposal date. Leaving unresolved rather than reusing an off-topic source.

Original ref (gxsngc.com) fails url_verifier (unrelated firm homepage). 79585.htm quotes the exact permit reference '兴业分输站进站道口交通行政许可证（桂交玉林高行政许可﹝2023﹞证字第11号）将于2026年4月12日到期' — the Xingye distribution-station entrance-road traffic permit bears a [2023] issuance tag. A road-access permit for a station entrance is normally obtained once the facility is built/commissioned, so this is consistent with — though not a direct commissioning announcement for — StartYear1=2023. Marked low/single-source because it's an indirect proxy (permit-issuance year, not an explicit 'put into operation' date) from one institutional publisher.

Single primary-source document (the operator's own e-procurement platform), so tier=medium rather than high.
